article.body:
By making a ‎ִמְִקְָּדָׁש ְמְַעַט in our __________.

Did you know that for ten days our mitzvos increase?

Imagine Hashem’s joy when all these “tens” gather in peace,

As He counts the many, many, many mitzvos we’ve _______!

No more desire to sin— we’ve chased the yetzer hora _______.

During these days of teshuva, Hashem yearns for our closeness, making it easier for us to connect to Him. Our complete unity

will be, of course, in the Beis Hamikdash and every child can bring that day closer by

Also remember that during this time, each person has ten times their usual power, like a minyan— and a gathering of Jews has an unbelievable effect!

The order of these days is like we say: ִׁׁשׁיר ַהַַּמֲַעֲלֹות 'ִמִַּמֲַעֲַמִַּקִים ְקְָרָאִתִיָך ה: Call out to Hashem, in a deep way, while He’s close, and He’ll protect us from doing wrong.
